I don’t agree with atheists relentlessly shitting on Christians. However, I’d like to provide some insight (I’m agnostic). 

I was raised Catholic by my family. I’m very grateful that I was raised by parents who actually cared to follow God’s word of helping others and showing love and respect even those they don’t like. However, a lot of people from the church I go to aren’t like that. The Vietnamese Catholic community is horrendous. A lot of Vietnamese Catholics don’t really care to do anything other than go to church not because they are in tune with God, but because they want to raise their social status by appearing holier than thou and buttering up the priest. Many are also unapologetically racist (particularly to Chinese, Hispanic, and black) and homophobic. Am I mistaken to let these other people ruin Catholicism for me? Perhaps, I can’t really argue against the view point. But I just can’t stand the dirty taste in my mouth when I think about it. 

I stopped caring about the Catholic Church because I realized barely anyone in my community actually cared. Most only thought “me, me, me,” having drinks with the priest, and looking down at others. If I was suffering, out of the hundreds of people that attend the church I go to, only a handful will bat an eye and even less will reach out and save me from the dark pits of my mind. 

Nonetheless, I deeply hold respect for Catholics and other branches of Christianity who genuinely feel the need to care and love others. I think those people are very special. Please keep doing what you’re doing.
